# Persona

`sales.obj.core.persona` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **core**

> A repeatable role archetype — VP Engineering, Head of RevOps — carrying the goals, pains, objections and language typical of it. Distinct from Contact along one clean line: a persona is a class and a contact is an instance, so everything on a persona is a prior and nothing on it is evidence about any individual. Distinct from ICP along another: an ICP describes the ACCOUNT worth selling to, a persona describes the PERSON inside it, and a perfect ICP match staffed by the wrong persona is a deal that dies in month three. Personas are how outreach and discovery become relevant before anything is known about the individual, which is precisely why treating a persona attribute as a discovered fact is the most expensive mistake available here.


Also called: `Buyer Persona`, `Role Archetype`, `Buyer Profile`

## Constraints

- **`persona.no_authority_transfer`** typical_authority may never be written to a Contactor Decision Maker as an observed value.
- **`persona.key_is_immutable`** persona_key cannot change once outcomes are attached toit. Rename display_name instead.
- **`persona.one_per_contact`** A contact carries exactly one active persona assignment.Two means the archetypes need splitting or merging.
- **`persona.retired_not_assignable`** A retired persona cannot be assigned to a new contact.
- **`persona.sample_gates_ranking`** win_rate_bp may not drive prioritisation below a minimumsample size set in the pack. _(soft)_


## Business rules

- **`persona.prior_never_becomes_fact`** A persona attribute may never be written onto a Contact, Stakeholder or Decision Maker as an observed value. typical_authority informs the opening line and can never raise Decision Maker confidence. This is the rule the object exists to enforce; every other rule here is hygiene.

- **`persona.anti_vocabulary_is_a_pre_send_filter`** A generated message containing an anti_vocabulary term is rejected before send, not scored down. A single wrong word costs the reply that the rest of the message earned, so this is a gate rather than a weight.

- **`persona.retired_blocks_compilation`** Outreach and discovery may not compile against a persona in state retired.
- **`persona.low_sample_cannot_rank`** Below roughly thirty attached contacts, win_rate_bp may describe the archetype and may not prioritise a territory. A high win rate on a sample of eight is an accident, and pointing a quarter of outreach at an accident is how a whole team's pipeline goes thin at once.

- **`persona.title_plus_size_is_the_key`** The same title in two company_size_bands is two personas, not one. Merging them produces an archetype that describes nobody.
- **`persona.calibration_expires`** A persona not recalibrated within a year is advisory only. Roles are reorganised more often than markets are.

## Actions

- **Draft the archetype** (human) — From real conversations, notfrom a template. A persona written from a template describes the template.
- **Assign to a contact** (system) — Attach with a confidence.Assignment is a claim and carries one.
- **Validate against outcomes** (human) — Requires the outcomejoin that does not exist yet — see the needs_signal patterns.
- **Split into two personas** (human) — The correct response tobimodal outcomes. Averaging them instead is the default and the mistake.
- **Recalibrate the definition** (human) — Annual at minimum,and immediately after a customer reorganisation wave.
- **Retire the persona** (human) — Blocks compilation; historystays attached to persona_key.


## Evidence

- **meeting_transcript** · 9000 bp — The archetype describing its own goalsin its own words. Nothing else is close.
- **call_recording** · 8500 bp — Objections in their natural order, includingthe ones nobody writes down.
- **crm** · 8000 bp — Closed outcomes by primary contact. The only sourcethat can validate rather than describe.
- **manual_entry** · 7000 bp — Seller-authored definition. High signal, andsystematically over-confident about authority.
- **email** · 6000 bp — Behavioural seat evidence in a live thread. Whatthe four executable patterns run on.
- **document** · 5000 bp — Job specifications. Accurate about accountability,silent about how they buy.
- **website** · 3500 bp — Public titles across a segment. Useful for typical_titlesand nothing else.
- **derived** · 4500 bp — Inferred assignment. Corroborating, and never asubstitute for the person telling you what they do.


## Metrics

- **assignment_coverage** (percent) — Share of live contacts with a persona assignedabove a confidence floor. Currently low, for the title reason above.
- **assignment_accuracy** (percent) — Share of assignments a human later confirms.Calibrates every executable pattern here.
- **reply_rate_by_persona** (percent) — The fastest read on whether the languagefields are right.
- **win_rate_by_persona** (percent) — Needs the outcome join. Until it exists thismetric is unmeasurable, not merely unmeasured.
- **sample_size** (count) — Contacts behind the archetype. Reported beside everyother number here or none of them mean anything.
- **calibration_age** (days) — Days since last_calibrated_at.


## Examples

- **VP Engineering at a 400-person SaaS company** — Technical evaluator, recommender atmost, measured on reliability and team velocity. Prefers technical proof and is repelled by an ROI model.
- **Head of RevOps at a 40-person company** — Same title as the enterprise persona and adifferent archetype entirely — they do the work themselves, buy to save their own evenings, and can often approve the spend.
- **CFO in a mid-market deal** — Economic buyer, data_led, evidence_preference roi_model.Two-week reply latency is normal for the band and is routinely misread as the deal cooling.
- **Head of Information Security** — typical_authority veto_only, typical_committee_roleblocker. Structurally cannot champion, and a deal whose only mapped seat is this one has no internal seller.
- **"Decision maker" as a persona** — The classic misclassification. That is an authorityfinding about an individual, not an archetype — it belongs on Decision Maker with evidence behind it, and as a persona it describes nobody and predicts nothing.

## Metadata

owner **Sales** · updated 2026-08-08 · review **unreviewed** · confidence **provisional**


> Ten patterns: four executable, six blocked. All four executable ones read behaviour rather than title, because behaviour is what the substrate can see. The highest-value signal gap is derived.persona_win_rate together with a terminal deal.outcome fact — every closed deal already records who it was sold to and nothing joins that back to the persona targeted, so every win_rate_bp in the library is permanently a guess and the validated calibration state is unreachable by construction. crm.contact.title_normalised is the second: without it assignment coverage stays low and outreach falls back to generic copy, which is the exact failure the object exists to prevent.
